response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates exceptional software engineering practices and 15+ years of development experience, they critically lack the mandatory requirements for this role. They have only ~6 months of documented C++ experience (December 2014–June 2015) versus the required 5–10 years, no Windows platform development background, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and zero capital markets or fixed income domain knowledge. The career trajectory shows web, mobile, and backend systems development, not the systems-level C++ work required for capital markets infrastructure.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship practices with demonstrated TDD, CI/CD implementation, and code quality focus across multiple roles
Extensive 15+ year development background spanning diverse technologies and domains showing adaptability and breadth
Excellent communication and mentoring abilities evidenced by workshop facilitation, public speaking, and active open-source contributions
concerns: Critical C++ experience gap: only ~6 months documented (Dec 2014–June 2015) at National Instruments versus required 5–10 years of strong hands-on experience
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain experience; career exclusively focused on web, mobile, and backend systems
Database and platform expertise mismatch: primary experience with MongoDB rather than SQL Server/Oracle; no Windows platform development mentioned in resume
